commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Benjamin Brand has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' Leandro Barreiro (Mainz) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Benjamin Brand had an easy-decision to make.
90+4' The number of shots on goal at present is 3:3.
90+2' Marco Richter (Mainz) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' An attempted cross from Anthony Caci (Mainz) is cleared.
86' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jeremie Frimpong leaves the pitch and Josip Stanisic (Bayer Leverkusen) comes on.
86' Here is a change. Jonas Hofmann is going off and Xabi Alonso gives the last tactical orders to Nadiem Amiri (Bayer Leverkusen).
84' It is time for a substitution. Marco Richter (Mainz) is on for Karim Onisiwo.
81' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Anthony Caci (Mainz), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
79' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Granit Xhaka as he is replaced by Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen).
79' Here comes a substitution. Victor Boniface is given a rest as he is replaced by Adam Hlozek (Bayer Leverkusen).
76' Bo Svensson has decided to substitute Brajan Gruda and he is replaced by Ludovic Ajorque (Mainz).
75' Brajan Gruda (Mainz) is yellow-carded.
74' Bayer Leverkusen take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
72' Leandro Barreiro (Mainz) commits a rough challenge and Benjamin Brand blows his whistle for a foul.
70' We are about to witness a subsitution. Aymen Barkok (Mainz) for Jae-Sung Lee.
69' The substitution has been made. Anwar El-Ghazi (Mainz) has replaced Danny da Costa.
69' Bo Svensson has decided to make a change. Tom Krauss (Mainz) replaces Dominik Kohr.
67' Odilon Kossounou (Bayer Leverkusen) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
65' 0 - 3 Goal! Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) takes a short pass from Amine Adli in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot into the bottom right corner. 0:3.
63' Substitution. Florian Wirtz walks off the pitch and Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) comes on as a substitute.
62' Brajan Gruda (Mainz) is adjudged offside.
59' 0 - 2 Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) scores a beautiful goal from the resulting free kick. He bends the ball into the top left corner. A technically stunning goal.
58' Edimilson Fernandes (Mainz) has tested the patience of referee Benjamin Brand and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
57' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen).
55' A cross from a corner kick by Mainz is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
54' Karim Onisiwo (Mainz) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the underside of the crossbar is brilliantly kept out by the goalkeeper.
54' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Mainz.
53' Karim Onisiwo (Mainz) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
52' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a cross into the box, but Robin Zentner comes off his line to gather the ball.
49' Danny da Costa (Mainz) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Lukas Hradecky intercepts the ball.
48' It's a throw-in for Mainz.
47' The ball is cleared after Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play and Mainz will have a goal kick.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' A lofted cross from Odilon Kossounou (Bayer Leverkusen) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
43' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 2:0.
40' Stefan Bell (Mainz) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
38' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen).
36' The ball is out of play. Mainz will take a throw-in.
35' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
32' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
31' Edimilson Fernandes (Mainz) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
31' Brajan Gruda (Mainz) had an opportunity from long range. His low shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Lukas Hradecky was alert and made a comfortable save.
30' Mainz are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
28' Robin Zentner (Mainz) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
27' Robin Zentner (Mainz) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
26' Benjamin Brand blows his whistle. Dominik Kohr (Mainz) commits a foul after dangerous play.
23' Wonderful movement by Bayer Leverkusen. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
21' It seemed like Brajan Gruda (Mainz) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
20' Danny da Costa (Mainz) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
18' 0 - 1 An unfortunate own goal is conceded by Sepp van den Berg (Mainz), who attempted to smack the ball away, but instead he sends it inside the right post of his own goal.
15' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
14' It looks like Karim Onisiwo (Mainz) saw red with that tackle. Benjamin Brand won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
13' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
12' Karim Onisiwo (Mainz) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
10' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the free kick and unleashes a strong shot from mid-range. Unfortunately for him, the ball curls inches over the crossbar. What a squandered chance!
7' Leandro Barreiro (Mainz) manages a fine header towards goal, but it misses the target as the ball flies past the left post.
5' Edimilson Fernandes (Mainz) tests the keeper from the free kick on the edge of the box. His decent effort goes a whisker wide of the left post.
4' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) is shown a yellow card for a late challenge.
4' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.
2' Poor challenge! Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) is penalised for tripping and Benjamin Brand blows his whistle.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Bayer Leverkusen will take the kick-off.
Benjamin Brand will officiate today.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
